scope: Four public-route gameplay screens and all three character selections in each of four viewport/input profiles, reviewed at original resolution after machine gates passed.
acceptedFindings: Landscape heroes retain head, hands, weapons, lower body, and feet with bottom margin; the chooser does not cover the silhouette.
Gameplay has no map-sized material rectangle, short-period color band, checkerboard collision ribbon, or abrupt two-scale terrain transition.
The forge and player remain separated and credibly scaled in every viewport.
Mobile Move, Strike, Ability, Tonic, cooldown, and Vitality presentation remains readable at native size.
The structural, landmark, and rendered-pixel checks catch the previously rejected composition classes.

The 118-pixel player remains readable and proportionate in all four gameplay profiles; the accepted Vanguard primary and south Arcanist ability strips show no scale pop, detached effect, foot shift, or recovery snap.
promotionRule: This verdict applies only while both the contract and ordered screenshot-set hashes match. CI must downgrade the gallery to candidate if either hash changes.
